mapper.select: SELECT questionId, MAX(CASE WHEN ${acceptedSql} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS accepted, MAX(CASE WHEN status IN (0, 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending FROM question_submit WHERE isDelete = 0 AND userId = #{userId} AND questionId IN (SELECT id FROM question WHERE isDelete = 0) GROUP BY questionId

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(createTime, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, COUNT(*) AS submitCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ${acceptedSql} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acceptedCount FROM question_submit WHERE isDelete = 0 AND userId = #{userId} AND createTime >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} - 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(createTime, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY day
SELECT COUNT(*) AS submitCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ${acceptedSql} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS acceptedCount FROM question_submit WHERE isDelete = 0 AND userId = #{userId}
